reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified as a real vulnerability. The 01e requirement (outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json, line 209) mandates: 'sidecar.index must be in range [0, NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS) to be accepted.' The gossip path correctly validates this via verify_data_column_sidecar (peerdas_helpers.nim:356), but the sync path (request_manager.nim:190) only calls verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof, which omits the index check. When sync responses are added to ColumnQuarantine via put() at request_manager.nim:437, the code calls getIndex(sidecar.index) which directly indexes indexMap[int(index)] without bounds checking (blob_quarantine.nim:237). Since indexMap is sized to NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS (128) at blob_quarantine.nim:830, an index >= 128 causes out-of-bounds array access before the doAssert at line 321. An attacker can trigger this via sync by sending data column sidecars with index >= 128, causing a crash or memory corruption. Severity calibrated to Medium per bug bounty rules: affects single client (Nimbus, <10% network share), meets the '>5% of network' threshold for Medium, and can be triggered with a single malicious sync response from an untrusted peer.
